basic_info.description: On a classic tree-lined street in the Marina, 3518 Scott is a full-floor flat that blends timeless charm with fresh updates. This 2-bedroom home checks all the right boxes: a sun-splashed living room with a fireplace and bay window, a formal dining room ready for dinner parties, and a renovated eat-in kitchen featuring brand-new counters, stainless steel appliances, and refreshed cabinet hardware. Newly refinished hardwood floors gleam underfoot, fresh interior paint brightens every room, and stylish new light fixtures tie it all together. Off the kitchen, you'll find a laundry room with stacked washer/dryer because who has time for laundromats? Both bedrooms are quietly tucked at the back, one with direct access to a private deck overlooking greenery and the shared yard below. Parking? Included. Peace of mind? Absolutely. The building has been structurally reinforced with a steel-beam seismic retrofit. Location? Unbeatable. Two blocks to Chestnut Street, three blocks to the Marina Green, and minutes to the Golden Gate Bridge. In short: the quintessential Marina flat, updated, secure, and ready for its next chapter.
